title: 字母频率
problem_statement_md:
你正在编写一个文本分析的程序。
输入一个文本和一个字母，计算该字母在文本中出现的频率，并以百分比的形式输出。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Letter Frequency[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are making a program to analyze text.
Take the text as the first input and a letter as the second input, and output the frequency of that letter in the text as a whole percentage.

[b]Sample Input:[/b]
hello
l

[b]Sample Output:[/b]
40

[b]Explanation : [/b]The letter [b]l[/b] appears 2 times in the text [b]hello[/b], which has 5 letters. So, the frequency would be [b](2/5)*100 = 40[/b].
[note]Division result is a float. Use the [b]int()[/b] function to convert the result to an integer.[/note]
hint_md: 除法结果是一个浮点数。使用`int()`函数将结果转换为整数。

code_templates.solution_code:
word = input()
letter = input()

print( int(word.count(letter)/len(word)*100))

testcases.explanation: 字母l在文本hello中出现2次，该文本有5个字母。因此，频率将是`(2/5)*100=40`
